mentions.name: official.page
mentions.description: A digital platform for creating a permanent online presence, structured as a personal knowledge graph where a person's thoughts and projects stay connected and discoverable over time, serving as a public record of their work.
mentions.source_excerpt: We are building official.page, a digital platform for creating a permanent online presence. Think of it as a personal knowledge graph where your thoughts and projects are connected and always discoverable—no matter how much time passes. It's a way to build a public record of your work.
